skillmap._note: Open Intelligence Bench skill map, v0 (2026-10-24). Each node is one skill: what it is, where its tasks come from, its state, held-out status and contamination record. Status: measured = scored runs with receipts; drafted = tasks written, nothing scored; planned = named only. Absorbed benchmarks are candidates until their licence and terms are verified; credit stays with the original authors.
principles: Local and free solutions are shown first; cloud entries show $ per run.
A headline score is the held-out score. Until a held-out run exists, the node says so and shows dev only.
Every result links its receipt: the exact settings, payload hashes and evidence files.
Every task set records where its text has been sent (contamination log).
